changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapSequence') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapSequence]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [MapItemID] [int] NOT NULL, [Sequence] [int] NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapSequence] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapSequence_MapItem') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapSequence] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapSequence_MapItem] FOREIGN KEY([MapItemID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapItem] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapSequence] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapSequence_MapItem] END
